history.content: Hey, I’m here. What’s been going on today?
eh. not much. just kind of annoyed if im honest
Yeah, annoyed makes sense. Is it more irritation, frustration, or that feeling of being blocked?
blocked i guess. my flatmate still hasnt paid me back for the bills. its been two months and i keep covering it
That sounds like the kind of annoyed that starts to feel blocked and worn thin, especially when you keep covering it. I’m learning there’s a fairness piece in it too.
yeah. its not even the money really its that i have to keep bringing it up like im the bad guy. anyway. its whatever
That sounds less like the money and more like being put in the bad-guy role for asking. If you want, we can leave it there.
Of course, we can leave it there. Thanks for telling me.
